settings.title: ToolHub Settings
settings.admin_pass_desc: Used to protect the Hub web interface (x-admin-password).
settings.agent_pass_desc: Security header sent by AI agent or SDK when executing tools.
settings.max_logs_desc: When this limit is exceeded, older execution logs are automatically pruned.
settings.root_nav_prompt_desc: This context is returned to the agent in the appendPrompt field when exploring the root / directory.
settings.root_nav_placeholder: Root skills directory. Use listTools('/folder') for navigation...
settings.system_protocol_prompt_desc: Base instructions for <hub></hub> tag syntax and Re-Act loops injected into the agent system prompt.

banner.text_1: 🛠️ToolHub is a centralized platform for tools and MCP. Built with native federation, minimal dependencies (Bun-only), and hierarchical navigation. If you like this philosophy, check out our dev blog.
banner.text_2: 🧪lab is a 100% serverless LLM client running directly in your browser. Zero middleman backends: connect any API provider and orchestrate 🛠️ToolHub skills out of the box.

chat.empty_state_desc: Advanced interface for local LLMs (Ollama) and OpenAI-compatible APIs. Create a new chat or select an existing one to get started.
chat.feature_1: Multi-provider hub supporting Ollama, OpenAI, and any compatible endpoints
chat.feature_2: Code-centric interface powered by Monaco Editor with native LaTeX math rendering
chat.feature_3: Surgical real-time token tracking via js-tiktoken and native Gemini Tokenizer
chat.feature_4: Deep context control: sliding window, message pinning, and live token analytics
chat.feature_5: Client-Full architecture: 100% private, zero-telemetry, offline-ready on IndexedDB
chat.feature_6: Agentic tool execution and workflow orchestration powered by ToolHub platform
chat.no_messages: Send a message to start the conversation.
chat.input_placeholder_no_model: Please select a model in the header first...
chat.input_placeholder_continue: Last message was from you. Click "Send" or press Enter to continue generation...
context.title: Control Panel
context.include_timestamps_desc: Appends exact date, time, and timezone [YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss TZ] to messages sent to the LLM.
context.temperature_desc: Controls randomness: 0.0 — strict and precise, 1.0+ — creative.
context.top_p_desc: Restricts token selection to cumulative probability P.
context.toolhub_desc: When enabled, the agent can use ToolHub tools to solve complex tasks in real time.
context.sliding_window_desc: When the limit is exceeded, oldest unpinned messages will be automatically evicted from context.
context.future_sub: MCP Servers, Web Search, Custom RAG Storages
context.graphmem_include_tools_desc: Store tool execution results in the knowledge graph alongside assistant responses.
context.confirm_delete_graphmem: Delete this knowledge graph from GraphMem? This action cannot be undone!
context.confirm_delete_last: Are you sure you want to delete the last {count} messages?
context.confirm_unpin_all: Unpin all messages in this chat?
context.alert_dialog_id_required: Please provide or generate a Dialog ID first
chat.graphmem_ingest_user_title: Ingest user prompt into Knowledge Graph
chat.graphmem_ingest_assistant_title: Ingest AI response into Knowledge Graph
chat.graphmem_include_tools_title: Include ToolHub tool calls in graph ingestion
chat.graphmem_freeze_title: Freeze weights and graph stepping during retrieval
chat.graphmem_notice_freeze_no_reply: Freeze applies only during context retrieval when AI response generation is enabled.
chat.graphmem_notice_mindsurf_no_ingest: Mind Surfer activates only after ingesting data or during AI response generation.
chat.graphmem_notice_sterile_readonly: Sterile Read-Only: AI responds using memory while the knowledge graph remains 100% untouched.
chat.graphmem_notice_partial_freeze: Freeze protects existing weights during search, but new messages will still create graph nodes.
chat.graphmem_notice_silent_history: Silent History Mode: Message is stored only in Short-Term Memory without graph ingestion.
chat.graphmem_notice_retrieval_only: Pure Retrieval Mode: GraphMem queries context and updates link weights without indexing new nodes.
settings.collapse_graphmem_snippets: Collapse GraphMem context blocks by default
settings.collapse_graphmem_snippets_desc: When enabled, retrieved GraphMem memory snippets in user messages will be automatically collapsed under a spoiler.
context.confirm_keep_last: Are you sure you want to keep only the last {count} messages and delete all older ones?
context.confirm_delete_first: Are you sure you want to delete the first {count} messages?
context.confirm_delete_heavy: Are you sure you want to delete the {count} heaviest messages by token weight?
context.confirm_compress_code: Are you sure you want to compress all code blocks in this chat? All code snippets will be replaced with "[CODE REMOVED TO SAVE CONTEXT]". This action cannot be undone.
context.graphmem_optimization_desc: Only the freshest memory snippets retrieved right before dispatch are sent to the LLM.
settings.title: Settings 🧪 lab
settings.add_provider_desc: Configure connection to Ollama (local) or OpenAI-compatible APIs (OpenAI, DeepSeek, OpenRouter).
settings.strip_latest_desc: Strip :latest suffix from model names on requests (useful for load balancers)
settings.no_providers: No LLM providers configured yet. Add one above.
settings.global_system_prompt_desc: This prompt will be prepended as a 'system' instruction to every request sent to the LLM.
settings.max_loops_desc: Maximum number of tool execution cycles per request. Prevents infinite generation loops.
settings.tokenizer_algo_desc: Select the tokenizer matching your model for accurate context calculation and sliding window management.
settings.font_size_desc: Choose a comfortable font size for reading messages and code in the chat area.
settings.collapse_tool_steps: Collapse tool execution chains by default
settings.collapse_tool_steps_desc: When enabled, ToolHub tool execution chains will be automatically collapsed. You can expand them with a single click.
settings.backup_desc: Export your entire chat history, threads, and provider configurations into a JSON file for backup or cross-device migration.
settings.language_desc: Select preferred language for the application interface.
settings.confirm_import: Warning! Importing a backup will completely overwrite your current database (all chats, messages, and providers). Proceed?
